lastCompletedStory.title: Real-git integration suite: on-main add/mod/del worktree coherence plus off-main regression

openQuestions: branchWasMain is vestigial since CAM-133 now that syncWorktreeIfOnMain self-detects the branch. Consider a cleanup story to remove it from specifyIssueOnMain/abandonIssueOnMain return shapes (not required by US-001 or US-002).
nextStoryContext: US-001 landed syncWorktreeIfOnMain in src/git/on-main.ts. US-002 added test/integration/sync-worktree-on-main.test.ts with four cases (ADD/MODIFY/DELETE/off-main regression) all asserting git status --porcelain is empty after commitTreeToMain. All 4 pass. US-003 requires a unit test that spies on process.stdout.write to assert the printWarning is emitted when git restore fails. The makeHappySpawn helper in test/on-main-multi.test.ts returns '' (empty) for --abbrev-ref by default so the sync is a no-op in existing tests; new on-main unit tests should return 'main' to exercise the restore path and a non-zero exit to trigger the warning. Pattern: inject a custom spawnFn that returns a failing status for the 'restore' subcommand and assert printWarning was called.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed: git restore --staged --worktree --source=HEAD defaults to no-overlay mode. In no-overlay mode, tracked paths absent from HEAD are removed from the working tree. This confirms the DELETE case works correctly with the current syncWorktreeIfOnMain implementation.
